For more information, see Obtaining a Database Handle. ### -param szTableName [in] Specifies the name of the relevant table. ## -returns This function returns MSICONDITION. ## -see-also General Database Access Functions ## -remarks > [!NOTE] > The msiquery.h header defines MsiDatabaseIsTablePersistent as an alias that automatically selects the ANSI or Unicode version of this function based on the definition of the UNICODE preprocessor constant. Mixing usage of the encoding-neutral alias with code that is not encoding-neutral can lead to mismatches that result in compilation or runtime errors.
